owner: The repository owner, who ran the session on their own workstation.
environment: macOS on Apple silicon, the pinned Claude Code 2.1.299 in print mode with setting sources project and local, golaw installed at project scope in a temporary repository enrolled with golaw init --apply, the candidate built with Go 1.27.2.
credential_boundary: The owner's own Claude Code login from the macOS keychain; no API key was created and the session read no other credential.
spending_limit: The usage limits of the owner's Claude plan; four one-turn sessions.
schedule: On demand before the v0.4.0 tag, again whenever the candidate, the toolchain or the pinned host changes.
retention: The debug logs stay on the owner's workstation; the temporary repository is kept there and its trust entry was removed after the session.
